# Released prompt-preset fixture

`play-presets-v0710.json.gz` is a gzip-compressed JSON envelope whose `library`
string was written by the public `FileNativePlayPresetStore` from tag `v0.7.10`,
commit `53d0aa4b65623d58e030e5f7f9b3f8669c683e14`, extracted using `git archive`.
It was generated by calling `initialize`, `create`, `save`, and `select` against
that historical implementation, then reading its library file. The envelope
records SHA-256 hashes of the three historical prompt/store source files,
current/draft revision identities and the historical structured projections.

It contains a selected first-person option, disabled output with a User role
and explicitly empty turn guide, Assistant scene role and custom turn guide,
User world placeholder, an interleaved disabled tabletop clone, a standalone
tail, disabled author guidance, a custom author prompt, a custom text asset,
and a distinct pending draft. The current implementation did not synthesize
or remove fields from the library bytes. Other synthetic ordered-list fixtures
in `tests/support/presetFixtures.ts` test behavior and are not release evidence.

To regenerate, export that exact tag into an isolated directory, install its
release dependencies, then run
`node scripts/generate-v0710-preset-fixture.mjs /absolute/release/root /tmp/fixture.json`.
Compress the generated JSON with `gzip -cn /tmp/fixture.json` to the fixture path.
The script checks the historical source hashes before importing any code.
